fullContentHtml:
HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has released the notification for the post of Food Safety Officer (FSO). This recruitment has been issued for 45 posts. The online application process for HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2026 will start from 28 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 19 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

How to Apply Online

  1. Click the official application link provided below.
  2. Register with your basic details (Name, Email, Mobile).
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address information.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  5. Pay the application fee online (if applicable).
  6. Submit the form and save the confirmation receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026?

HPSC Food Safety Officer (FSO) Online Form 2026 is an official government recruitment / examination notification. Complete details including eligibility, important dates, and direct links are provided above.

Where can I find the official link?

The official link is: https://hpsc.gov.in/en-us/

How to apply online?

Click on the Apply Online link given above, register on the official portal, fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee before the last date.
